purpose: Re-evaluate existing memory-v2 and FASE code against the pre-integration 1.4.0 behavior on saved evaluation forecasts
scope: Regression comparison on previously inspected data, not a new holdout or paper reproduction
v2_profile: returns for alpha; intermittent for Favorita; levels for crypto indicators (identical to current defaults)
bounded: Change distance only; preserve features, window, k, own weighting and selector
fase: FASE 18-feature profile plus bounded distance and 100/900 retention; preserve explicit window, k, own weighting and selector
selection_rules: No shrinkage, confidence penalty, novelty abstention or switch penalty is enabled
models_and_targets: Original saved forecasts, original series, origins, maturity times, warmup cutoffs and metrics; no refits or paid calls
inference: Paired 95% circular-block bootstrap across all series together: 28 origins for alpha/crypto, 112 for Favorita; 2000 draws, seed 0. Favorita also paired series bootstrap. Exploratory, no multiplicity adjustment.
promotion: Do not change live defaults or choose per-task winning settings from these results
baseline: b741aa68bd86d534753ba3b8e5788d720c8c3543; verify current replay against saved original results and independent old-code retrieval samples
no_memory: Additional descriptive control included after the run began; disables memory only, preserves pooling and all other settings. No candidate tuning.
